en: A sepia-toned photograph of a rustic rural courtyard or farmstead surrounded by several old vernacular houses with steeply pitched thatched or shingled roofs. The buildings are made of rough stone and plaster, with wooden balconies, exterior staircases, and various farm tools, ladders, and troughs scattered around. A narrow, unpaved lane runs up the right side, bordered by a low stone wall. The overall look is early‑20th‑century European countryside. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image side.
